sub_answers.text: Wang Shanshan was named captain of China's final 23-player squad for the 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup announced on 5 July 2023 [d73917455s13p0]. Zhang Rui was named vice-captain for that tournament in the same announcement on 5 July 2023 [d73917455s13p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: Provide examples and timelines showing how the athlete influenced national team selection or rotation decisions—such as prompting changes to starting lineups, earning automatic selection policies, or altering training-group assignments—and cite selection announcements, coach statements, or squad lists.

Provide a year-by-year chronology of the player’s official ITTF senior world ranking throughout their senior career: for each calendar year give the ranking position(s) (month or list release date), ITTF ranking points if available, highest and lowest rank that year, and note major causes for significant rises or drops (e.g., big tournament wins, injuries, breaks, suspensions).

sub_answers.text: Wang Shanshan was named team captain of the China women's national team for the 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup by head coach Shui Qingxia in the final 23-player squad announced on 5 July 2023 [d73917455s13p0]. Zhang Rui was named vice-captain for the tournament by head coach Shui Qingxia in the same announcement on 5 July 2023 [d73917455s13p0].
